thread:
alexa: Heads-up — console quota card showing negative available tokens for 3 shared-tenant orgs. Not seeing invoice spikes, just dashboard numbers. Anyone else?

nina: yep seeing it too. Sample tenants were all migrated into the new routing-policy v3 at ~03:10 UTC. Looks correlated.

zack: quick look at the ingest logs — we're getting two meter increments for the same external_request_id when route_hint is present. dedupe key in preview-agg doesn't include route_hint. logs: `put_meter(req_id=0x7f3a, tenant=t-42, route=primary)` then `put_meter(req_id=0x7f3a, tenant=t-42, route=shadow)`

metering-bot: alert: metering.duplicate_increments rate=7 for tenant t-42 (threshold=5)

alexa: ah that explains negative available. Is this only preview/console pipeline or also the final ledger?

sre-jen: queried final ledger quickly — canonical ledger uses (req_id, tenant) and also normalizes route_tag -> so far final ledger counts match historical and no double-billing. This looks isolated to the preview/aggregate stream we use for the console.

nina: repro query I ran against preview stream:
```
SELECT tenant_id, route, count(*) as c
FROM preview_metering.events
WHERE timestamp >= '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z' AND tenant_id IN ('t-42','t-77','t-81')
GROUP BY tenant_id, route
ORDER BY tenant_id;
```

nina: result shows both primary+shadow increments for same reqs.

devex: UX concern — console's quota card just shows a single "available" number. We need a graceful way to hide preview-only anomalies from end-users (especially resellers). Could add a flag "hide-preview-duplicates" per org while we fix.

zack: quick patch idea in preview-agg: include route_hint in dedupe key (simple):
```
- dedupe_key = req_id
+ dedupe_key = f"{req_id}|{route_hint or 'none'}"
```

alexa: that will dedupe the primary+shadow problem in preview. Any risk we undercount? If the shadow path sometimes intentionally duplicates (for shadow testing) we want to keep one copy, so this is fine.

dave: agree but we should also ensure ordering — if the primary arrives after shadow we still dedupe. dedupe window is 30s now; might need to bump to 60s temporarily.

sre-jen: operational plan: 1) toggle routing-policy v3 -> fallback for the 3 affected shared-tenants (canary rollback) 2) deploy hotfix to preview-agg to include route_hint in dedupe key + increase window to 60s 3) restart preview-agg consumer for those shards 4) run a correction job to recompute preview counters for the 3 tenants for the 03:00-03:30 window 5) keep console flag to hide preview counts until next deploy is verified.

alexa: can someone own the patch + PR? I'll own the rollback toggles and console flag.

nina: I can pick the correction job and run the ledger vs preview diff to prove fixes.

zack: I'll draft the patch this afternoon and open a PR against preview-agg. Will include unit tests for dedupe and an integration test that simulates primary+shadow duplication.

metering-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0315-508 (severity: P2) by metering-bot

triage-bot: action items assigned: alexa (console-flag + rollback), zack (preview-agg hotfix), nina (recompute job), dave (window config), sre-jen (monitoring post-deploy)

alexa: timeline? if zack can get a PR up in ~3h we can canary the fix in staging and push to canary shards by EOD. I want the rollback in place until fix lands.

dave: +1. Also we'll add a short-term dashboard that compares "preview_counts - canonical_ledger_counts" per tenant to catch regressions.

sre-jen: note for postmortem: call out that route_hint was introduced in routing-policy v3 but preview pipeline's dedupe contract wasn't updated. Add rollout checklist item: confirm dedupe contract compatibility for any new routing metadata.

alexa: good call. I'll add that to the rollout playbook.

nina: FYI there are 2 more tenants with faint drift — likely same cause. I'll include them in the recompute job.

zack: PR link when ready: will paste back here.

alexa: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for status — will post when rollback is toggled.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0315-508 updated: status -> in_progress

alexa: rollback done for the original 3 tenants (03:28 UTC). monitoring looks better but leaving the incident open until patch + recompute complete.

sre-jen: initial post-patch check (staging) shows preview delta reduced to 0 for test tenant. good sign.

alexa: closing the loop later with postmortem draft once backfill and prod deploy finish.
